"""Cyclic cubic calibration, cosine operator, and two-mode readout."""
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares


def _ls(a, b):

def _panel_features(study, x):
    (a, c) = (study['panel_a'], study['panel_c'])
    (u, v) = (a['u'], a['v'])
    f = _affine(u)
    fit = np.linalg.lstsq(f, v, rcond=None)[0]
    for _ in range(10):
        err = np.linalg.norm(f @ fit - v, axis=1)
        keep = np.argsort(err)[:int(0.82 * len(u))]
        fit = np.linalg.lstsq(f[keep], v[keep], rcond=None)[0]
    maps = np.linalg.lstsq(_affine(c['u']), c['v1'], rcond=None)[0]
    raw = _affine(x) @ maps
    calibrated = (x - fit[0]) / fit[1:].diagonal()
    aligned = _affine(calibrated) @ maps
    squash = lambda q: q / np.sqrt(1 + 0.09 * q * q)
    return (_basis(squash(raw)), _basis(squash(aligned)), calibrated)

def _ridge(x, y, q, penalty):
    return q @ np.linalg.solve(x.T @ x + penalty * np.eye(x.shape[1]), x.T @ y)

def solve_batch(study: dict) -> dict:
    train = study['train']
    n = len(train['x'])
    x = np.vstack((train['x'], study['test']['x']))
    (raw, aligned, calibrated) = _panel_features(study, x)
    hybrid = np.column_stack((aligned, _basis(calibrated)))
    y = 0.8 * _ridge(hybrid[:n], train['y'], hybrid[n:], 0.007)
    y += 0.2 * _ridge(raw[:n], train['y'], raw[n:], 0.012)
    z = train['traj']
    time_basis = np.linalg.svd(z, full_matrices=False)[2][:2]
    amps = z @ time_basis.T
    state = (0.5 * _ridge(raw[:n], amps, raw[n:], 0.014) + 0.5 * _ridge(aligned[:n], amps, aligned[n:], 0.014)) @ time_basis
    return {'y_hat': y, 'state_pred': state, 'diagnostics_vec': np.array([y.mean(), y.std(), state[:, -1].mean(), state[:, -1].std()])}

def _coordinates(study, x):
    a = study['panel_a']
    (u, v) = (a['u'], a['v'])
    (i, j) = np.triu_indices(len(u), 1)
    (du, dv) = (u[i] - u[j], v[i] - v[j])
    gain = np.array([np.median(dv[abs(du[:, k]) > 0.1, k] / du[abs(du[:, k]) > 0.1, k]) for k in range(u.shape[1])])
    offset = np.median(v - u * gain, axis=0)
    residual = np.linalg.norm(v - offset - u * gain, axis=1)
    median = np.median(residual)
    keep = residual <= max(8 * median, 0.001)
    if keep.sum() >= 2 * u.shape[1]:
        coef = [_least(_affine(u[keep, k:k + 1]), v[keep, k]) for k in range(u.shape[1])]
        (offset, gain) = np.array(coef).T
    cal = (x - offset) / gain
    b = study['panel_b']
    op = _least(_affine(b['u']), b['v'])
    return (x, cal, _affine(x) @ op, _affine(cal) @ op)
